hero.subtitle: KisanSetu connects farmers with procurement centres through smart slot booking, real-time queue tracking, and transparent MSP payout updates.

value_strip.slots_desc: Schedule convenient arrival times to avoid peak mandi hours
value_strip.queue_desc: Track your live queue position and estimated wait duration
value_strip.i18n_desc: Full interface available in major Indian regional languages
value_strip.payout_desc: Transparent weight logs, MSP calculations, and bank updates

how_it_works.step1_desc: Register crop details and estimated harvest quantity from your mobile phone.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Select a convenient date and hourly time slot at your nearest mandi.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Get an offline-accessible digital QR token code with slot confirmation.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Check live vehicle queue count and arrival notifications on your phone.
how_it_works.step5_desc: Scan QR at gate, verify weight & quality grade, and track MSP bank transfer.

farmer_section.title: Built Specifically for Farmers
farmer_section.subtitle: High contrast for outdoor sunlight readability, large touch targets, and digital tokens that work offline even without cellular connectivity.

centre_section.title: Streamlining Mandi Operations
centre_section.subtitle: Empowering procurement centre staff with camera QR scanning, automated weighbridge gross/tare calculations, and instant digital procurement slips.

multilingual_section.title: Technology Should Speak the Farmer's Language
multilingual_section.subtitle: KisanSetu is built with an extensible translation architecture supporting Indian regional languages with seamless runtime switching.
multilingual_section.note: Designed for continuous expansion across all Indian agricultural regions.

smart_ops.title: Smart Procurement Logistics
smart_ops.subtitle: Data-driven capacity management and queue algorithms solving real procurement problems.
smart_ops.op1_desc: Calculates hourly vehicle quotas based on actual weighbridge throughput.
smart_ops.op2_desc: Provides real-time waiting time estimates based on active vehicle processing speed.
smart_ops.op3_desc: Visual green/yellow/red indicators for district officers to balance intake.
smart_ops.op4_desc: Digital gross/tare weight logging with tamper-proof HMAC signature verification.

impact_section.title: Solving Mandi Procurement Bottlenecks
impact_section.subtitle: Target operational improvements for agricultural procurement during peak harvest seasons.

final_cta.title: Make Every Procurement Visit Predictable.
final_cta.subtitle: Join thousands of farmers and mandi staff reducing congestion across procurement centres.

footer.desc: KisanSetu is a multilingual smart procurement management platform connecting farmers, procurement centre staff, and administrators.
footer.sih_ref: Developed for Smart India Hackathon Problem Statement 26032.
